The  distributive  law  has  for  corollaries  the 
following  formulae : 

ab  +  cd  =  (a  +  c)  (b  +  c)  (a  +  d)  (b  +  d), 

(a  +  b)  (c  +  d)  =  ac  +  bc  +  ad  +  bd. 
These  formulae,  as  well  as  all  those  already 
given,  show  that  there  is  a  perfect  correlation, 
or  duality,  between  addition  and  multiplica 


tion,  which  consists  in  the  fact  that  the  signs
